children: Overview
Italy fresh produce distributor's H1 2026 revenue grew 1.8% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITDA margin for H1 2026 declined to 5.3%
Adjusted net profit for H1 2026 fell compared to H1 2025
Outlook
Company says recent growth initiatives drive updated investment and net financial position targets
Orsero highlights market resilience and strategic focus after acquiring 45% of Trucco Holdings
Result Drivers
HIGH VALUE FRUIT - Revenue growth driven by increased volumes and prices in high value-added categories including berries, kiwi, and exotic fruit
BANANA WEAKNESS - Lower volumes and unsatisfactory performance in bananas, Canary plantains, and pineapples offset gains in other categories
COST INCREASES - Declining margin attributed to higher warehouse, personnel, and general administrative costs, partly due to indirect impacts from the Middle East crisis

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the food retail & distribution peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Orsero SpA is €25.90, about 50.4% above its September 9 closing price of €17.22
The stock recently traded at 11 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
